A superbly clever take on the Looney Tunes world and the evil ACME! The animation is superb, as well as its blending with reality. The story is so smart and well narrated and told, with good laughs, a bit of the nostalgia factor and a lot of modern messages in the movie too.
A solid animation movie for all ages, from kids of today to the kids of yesterday who grew up with these characters. :)

I’m just happy as hell that we actually got to see this movie after it almost never got released. Having Wile E. Coyote finally get tired of ACME products constantly fucking him over and SUING THEM is such a perfect Looney Tunes idea. It’s funny, ridiculous and surprisingly has a lot of heart.

I especially love that underneath all the cartoon insanity, it’s about corporate greed, perseverance and the little guy finally standing up to something much bigger than himself. And considering this movie itself was almost thrown away by a giant corporation, that theme hits even harder. Most importantly, it actually feels like Looney Tunes. Really fucking good it’s a 9/10 for me.
Really good, it’s a crime that Warner Bros had shelved this as a tax write off…
